title: Neon Pulse — Episode 1: The First Flicker
description: Kael discovers a strange, rhythmic energy pulsing within his veins, marking the start of a journey he never asked for.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: They said the blackout was just a surge in the grid. But I felt it—a vibration under my skin that didn't stop when the lights died.
scenes.visual: young man clutching his glowing forearm in a dark alley, frantic expression, dim industrial environment

scenes.narration: My hands won't stop shaking. Every time I touch metal, the air hums like a live wire ready to snap.
scenes.visual: fingertips hovering near a metallic surface, static electricity arcing, intense focus

scenes.narration: I thought I was alone in this apartment. But then the shadows started moving with a rhythm that matched my own heartbeat.
scenes.visual: crouching in a dim room, looking back over shoulder, dark silhouettes shifting on the wall

scenes.narration: There is a pattern here. A code hidden in the hum, pulling me toward the derelict sector of the city.
scenes.visual: staring at a complex holographic projection flickering in the dark, wide-eyed curiosity

scenes.narration: I don't know who is watching, but the air grows cold whenever I reach for the truth. Something is hunting for what I have.
scenes.visual: peering through a cracked wall, silhouettes of armored figures moving in the distance

scenes.narration: I have to leave, before they realize I'm not just a malfunction. My life changed in a single heartbeat.
scenes.visual: running through a narrow corridor, frantic movement, blurry motion, escaping into the night

scenes.narration: This is only the beginning of the noise. If you want to see where this power leads, stay tuned.
scenes.visual: standing on a high rooftop overlooking a vast, glowing city at night, silhouette against neon lights
